notes: Follow-up to Guild Clearance. Three fixes. (1) DOUBLE CREDIT: a cargo drone docking ran state.runBanked += cd.carryingValue AND sent its own bank_delta for the same value, and the end of run settlement then sent runBanked as a delta too, so every drone haul was paid twice. Ferried value now tracks in state.runFerried and goes straight to state.bank, credited once. (2) PER MESSAGE CAP: the server deleted the run window on the FIRST positive delta, so with cargo drones banking mid run every later message fell through to the 90 second fallback and got a FRESH FULL CAP. The ceiling was never 450k per run, it was 450k times however many bank messages a client chose to send. The budget is now cumulative per run and only the end of run settlement closes the window. Five forged claims of 1,000,000 now credit 897 total where they previously credited 2.25M. (3) THE CEILING WAS 31x THE PHYSICALLY IMPOSSIBLE MAXIMUM. Derived from the game's own numbers: LASER_MINE_RATE 1.6 against a threshold of 100 with the best drillMul of 1.75 is 0.60s per ore unit, the richest mineral is 250, and heat duty cycles at 38%, so about 160 F/sec assuming every rock is musgravite with zero travel. MINING_MAX_YIELD_PER_SEC drops 5000 to 400 and MINING_MAX_RUN_BANK drops 10M to 500k. Near cap claims now log to admins as well as clamped ones, since a tuned forgery sits just under the ceiling and the old log was silent there. Also rewords the zero clearance prompt to routes a new player actually has. SERVER RESTART REQUIRED, no schema change beyond 1.3.7.0.
